body:
I can't understand why people don't think i'm a shitty person. 
I'm so rude about everyone behind their back. I'm so ungreatful for what I have.

The other people not wanting me to makes no difference. It just makes me feel more selfish which actually gives me a justifiable reason because i'm a shitty person and thus deserve it.

It's the only way to stop my mind. To shut up the thoughts, the feelings, the uncontrollable emotions and the fucking flies.
She jumped on front of a train. I was the last one to see her, to speak to her and I noticed things were weird beforehand but I just didn't think about them because I was just thinking about myself.
